def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] in (1,2)]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=pts[0],pts[1]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    n=max(abs(r2-r1),abs(c2-c1))
    if n==0: return out
    for i in range(1,n):
        r=round(r1+(r2-r1)*i/n); c=round(c1+(c2-c1)*i/n)
        out[r][c]=3
    return out

import json
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1]
    twos=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
    (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=ones[0],twos[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
    adr,adc=abs(dr),abs(dc)
    sr,sc=(1 if dr>0 else -1),(1 if dc>0 else -1)
    if adc>adr:
        # straight horizontal, adjacent to 2, going toward 1
        L=abs(adc-adr)+1
        cols=[c2-sc*i for i in range(1,L+1)]
        row=r2-sr
        for c in cols: out[row][c]=3
        # diagonal from end of straight toward 1
        r,c=row,cols[-1]
        for i in range(adr-2):
            r,c=r-sr,c-sc
            out[r][c]=3
    else:
        L=abs(adr-adc)+1
        rows=[r2-sr*i for i in range(1,L+1)]
        col=c2-sc
        for r in rows: out[r][col]=3
        r,c=rows[-1],col
        for i in range(adc-2):
            r,c=r-sr,c-sc
            out[r][c]=3
    return out
